Do we have any nodes running on ipv6? Are there ways to test/force the use of ipv6 for a client? Ok, just configured my staking machine for ipv6 only and that failed pretty much. Neither lighthouse nor prysm find any peers. Both start their p2p service with an ipv4 address Teku works with IPv6 but finding peers only on IPv6 will be very difficult as there are almost node that advertise IPv6 addresses. Theoretically its possible to advertise both v4 and v6 addresses in a single ENR but I'm not sure if any clients do. I've run a number of IPv6 only testnets without issue in the past though. Ok, I might also try teku for this. Would I need an ipv6 boot node, is there one? Let me check if our bootnode has IPv6 I think it might. Hmm, doesn't seem to have public IPv6.
